title: Valencia Crush Barca to Win the Second Liga Title in Their History
description: Valencia Basket are champions of Spain. The Taronja produced a commanding 108-84 win at the Palau Blaugrana to close out the Liga Endesa finals 3-1 and lift the second league title in the club's history, the crowning moment of a superb season. Widely regarded as the best team in Europe over the course of the campaign, Valencia simply overwhelmed Barca with their physicality, intensity and shooting. Pedro Martinez's side took control with another irresistible display from Jean Montero (188-PG-2003), who finished with 23 points, three assists and two rebounds, superbly complemented by Kameron Taylor (198-SF-1994, college: Seton Hill) (21 points, six rebounds) and the marksmanship of Omari Moore (198-SG-2000, college: SJSU) (19 points on 4-of-6 from three). Valencia shot 53 percent from two and 48 percent from three as a team, exploiting Barca's defensive frailties and absorbing the hosts'…
imageCaption: Valencia Crush Barca to Win the Second Liga Title in Their History (Photo: Valencia)

title: Real Madrid sweep Valencia, claim second straight Liga Endesa title
description: Valencia - Real Madrid 70-81 Real Madrid clinched the second consecutive Liga Endesa title. They beat Valencia on the road tonight to sweep the Finals. The guests trailed by 1 point at the halftime before their 42-30 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when Real Madrid made 9 blocks. The best player for the winners was Croatian Mario Hezonja (202-1995) who scored 16 points and 9 rebounds. Argentinian point guard Facundo Campazzo (181-1991) chipped in 9 points and 8 assists. At the other side the best for losing team was the former international Xabier Lopez-Arostegui (200-1997) who recorded 14 points and Dominican guard Jean Montero (188-2003) added 12 points and 5 rebounds (went 8 for 8 at the free throw line) respectively. Four Valencia players scored in double figures. Both coaches used bench…
imageCaption: Real Madrid sweep Valencia, claim second straight Liga Endesa title (Photo: Real Madrid)

title: Real Madrid sweep Murcia, earn Liga Endesa title
description: Murcia - Real Madrid 73-84 Real Madrid swept Murcia to earn Liga Endesa title. The guests trailed by 8 points at the halftime before their 52-33 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Real Madrid made 18-of-20 free shots (90.0 percent) during the game. Real Madrid had a 32-19 advantage in offensive rebounds. 25 personal fouls committed by Murcia helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a great evening for Argentinian point guard Facundo Campazzo (180-1991) who led his team to a victory scoring 13 points, 7 rebounds, 6 assists and 4 steals. Bosnian swingman Dzanan Musa (205-1999) helped adding 18 points and 4 assists. The best for the losing side was Canadian-Jamaican guard Dylan Ennis (188-1991, college: Oregon) with 18 points and 5 rebounds and Cuban guard Howard Sant-Roos (201-1991, agency: Octagon Europe) scored 10 points and 5 rebounds.…
imageCaption: Real Madrid sweep Murcia, earn Liga Endesa title (Photo: Liga Endesa)

title: Barca are 22/23 Liga Endesa champions
description: Real Madrid - Barca 82-93 Barca conquered Liga Endesa 22/23 title. They beat Real in Madrid tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series. The victory marked the 20th ACB title for the Catalan team. The guests trailed by 3 points at the halftime before their 55-41 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Barca looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. It was a good game for Czech center Jan Vesely (213-1990) who led his team to a victory with 19 points. The former international Nikola Mirotic (208-1991) contributed with 14 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Four Barca players scored in double figures. Naturalized Cape Verdean center Walter Tavares (220-1992) answered with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 11 rebounds and French Guerschon Yabusele (204-1995) added 10 points in the effort for Real Madrid. Both coaches used bench…
imageCaption: Barca are 22/23 Liga Endesa champions (Photo: Sara Gordon (@saragb)/FC Barcelona)

title: Real Madrid capture Liga ACB title
description: Real Madrid - Barca 81-74 Real Madrid are 2021/22 Liga ACB champions. They overcame Barca in the fourth game of the Final to clinch the trophy. Walter Tavares (220-C-1992) notched 25 points and 13 rebounds to pace the hosts and was named the MVP. Real Madrid limited their opponents to just 10 points in the first period to take a 3-point lead. Barca sank 23 points in the second frame to narrow the deficit at 1-point 34-33. The teams went neck and neck throughout the third term. Real Madrid entered the fourth quarter up by one point. The hosts then finished the game strong. Real poured in 24 points in the fourth stanza and raced to the first Liga ACB title since 2018/19 season. Fabien Causeur (196-F-1987) posted 17 points to lead the winners. Nikola Mirotic (208-PF-1991) replied with 14 points for Barca. Dante Exum (198-PG-1995, agency: Alti Sport) had 13 points in the loss.
imageCaption: Real Madrid capture Liga ACB title (Photo: acb.com)

title: Barca celebrate Liga Endesa title
description: Barca - Real Madrid 92-73 Barca clinched Liga Endesa title. They eased past Real Madrid in the second game of the Finals to complete the sweep. The game was mostly controlled by FC Barcelona. Real Madrid managed to win fourth quarter 18-15. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. The former international Nikola Mirotic (208-91) scored 27 points and 5 rebounds to lead the charge for the winners and Greek-American point guard Nick Calathes (197-89, college: Florida) chipped in 15 points and 7 assists during the contest. Four FC Barcelona players scored in double figures. Naturalized Cape Verdean center Walter Tavares (220-92) responded with 12 points and 6 rebounds and international guard Carlos Alocen (194-0) scored 11 points and 5 assists. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: Barca celebrate Liga Endesa title (Photo: acb.com)
